items.prompt: I stated the purpose in my first sentence.
items.tip: Lead with why you are calling. People listen better when they know where the call is going.
items.keepDoing: You opened with purpose. Keep it.

items.prompt: I let them finish before responding.
items.tip: Count one beat after they stop before you answer. It signals you heard them.
items.keepDoing: You gave them room to finish. That builds trust fast.

items.prompt: We ended with a clear next step and owner.
items.tip: Close with: so you will do X by Y, and I will do Z. Say it out loud.
items.keepDoing: You closed with a clear next step and owner. Keep ending calls that way.
